function: Spatial-temporal extrapolation of time-varying cascaded BS-RIS-user channels: predicts later OFDM symbols from earlier ones and reconstructs all RIS elements from a subset (p. 2-3).
system: Reflecting RIS 16 elements, BS ULA 4 antennas, single-antenna user at 100 km/h, mmWave OFDM, 32 subcarriers, 15 kHz spacing; carrier frequency not given (p. 2, 4).
method: Supervised deep learning: TCN-based temporal prediction network (TPreNet) plus ExtraNet from [9] for spatial extrapolation, with structured probabilistic pruning via selection network; MSE loss, Adam (p. 3-4).
data_channel: DeepMIMO dataset, scenario O1: 36000 samples, 5 paths, user in 40 m x 36.2 m region, random direction; 4:1 train/test split (p. 4).
test_conditions: 4:1 train/test split of the same 36000-sample DeepMIMO O1 data; sweeps over observed length, sampling rate, compression rate and SNR (p. 4-5).
baselines: Non-pruned network, dropout, uniform pruning and random pruning variants of the same network; no classical estimator and no earlier learned extrapolation method compared (p. 4-5).
metrics: NMSE of the extrapolated cascaded channel in dB, versus observed length, spatial sampling rate, compression rate and SNR; model size (p. 4-5).
complexity: FLOPs formulas for TCNNet, PredNet, ExtraNet; Big-O O(K|Tl|^2) for TPreNet and O(K|Tl|) for ExtraNet; model sizes 15347 to 126851 parameters (p. 4-5).
q2_support: p. 4: "In the ratio of 4:1, the data samples are divided into the training set and the testing set."
q3_support: p. 4: "the extrapolation that adopts the probabilistic pruning and the dropout"
q4_support: p. 4: "the Big-O notation, the computational complexity of the TPreNet and ExtraNet can be simplified as"
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. q1 and q5: scenario O1 of the public DeepMIMO dataset (p. 4, ref. [20] on p. 6); time variation comes from the paper's own Doppler model (p. 2), and the carrier frequency of O1 is not stated. q2 = 0: a 4:1 split of one dataset, and the sweeps over observed length, sampling rate and SNR do not state a model trained in one setting and tested in another. q3 = 0: every comparison (non-pruning, dropout, uniform and random pruning, Fig. 4-5, Table II) is a variant of the proposed network; no classical method and no earlier learned method such as ExtraNet alone or an LSTM predictor.
